badge.unverifiedBody: Pronunciations, Chinese phonetics and meanings have not yet been checked by a qualified teacher. Use them as a study aid and follow your teacher's instruction.
badge.placeholderVoiceBody: Computer speech stands in until real recordings by a qualified chanter are added. It is not an authentic pronunciation.

home.title: Learn to chant
home.intro: Pronunciation, script and meaning, one phrase at a time.

reader.transmission: Traditionally, mantra practice is received through a reading transmission (lung) from a qualified teacher. This app is a study aid and does not replace a teacher.

player.label: Player
player.abHint: Repeat a section: starts at the current position; press “Set B” to choose its end.

script.stacksIntro_one: {{count}} syllable in this text uses a stack or a special sign.
script.stacksIntro_other: {{count}} syllables in this text use stacks or special signs.
script.sanskritNote: This is Sanskrit written in Tibetan script, so it is read letter by letter rather than by Tibetan spelling rules.

memorize.addHint: Add this text's phrases to your daily review.
memorize.clozeIntro: Some syllables are hidden. Chant the phrase, then tap a gap to check.
memorize.chainIntro: Learn phrase 1, then 1–2, then 1–3… Recite every phrase so far from memory before moving on.
memorize.chainDone: You can chant the whole text!
memorize.memoryIntro: Chant the whole text without looking. Peek only when you're stuck; peeks are counted.

record.intro: Record yourself chanting a phrase and compare it with the reference.
record.micDenied: Couldn't use the microphone. Check your browser's permission settings.
record.saveFailed: The recording couldn't be saved on this device.
record.slower: You're a lot slower than the reference. That's fine while learning; speed up as it becomes familiar.
record.faster: You're faster than the reference. Slow down and give each syllable its full sound.
record.goodPace: Your pace is close to the reference.
record.privacy: Recordings stay on this device. They are never uploaded.

alphabet.title: Alphabet
alphabet.toneNote: Readings are approximate Central Tibetan (Lhasa). Gold letters are high tone, grey are low tone. Tap to hear.
alphabet.vowelNote: Every consonant carries an “a”. A vowel sign above or below changes it.

anatomy.title: Syllable anatomy
anatomy.intro: See how a syllable is built from its parts.
anatomy.how: Each syllable is built around a root letter. A superscript can sit on top of it and a subscript below. A prefix can come before it and up to two suffixes after it. Syllables are separated by a dot (tsheg ་).
anatomy.limits: The breakdown follows standard spelling rules. A few rare three-letter syllables are ambiguous; ask a teacher if a result looks wrong.

review.title: Review
review.empty: Nothing to review yet. Open a text's Memorize tab and add it to your daily review.
review.allDone_one: All done for now. {{count}} phrase reviewed.
review.allDone_other: All done for now. {{count}} phrases reviewed.

mala.title: Mala counter
mala.desc: Count recitations by tapping. Every count is saved to your tracker.
mala.keysHint: Tap the circle or press Space. Browsers don't let web apps use the volume buttons. The screen stays on while counting.

session.title: Guided session
session.desc: Refuge, then the mantra, then dedication, with a timer.

tracker.title: Accumulations
tracker.desc: Your recitations over time, toward a goal.

settings.title: Settings
settings.traditionHint: Tibetan is how mantras are chanted in Tibetan Buddhism (“benza sato”). Sanskrit restores the original sounds (“vajrasattva”). Follow your teacher's lineage.
settings.reminderNote: Reminders only appear while the app is open in a tab or installed and running.
settings.notifDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser's site settings to use reminders.
settings.toolsHint: Time a real recording to each syllable so karaoke follows the chanter.
settings.aboutBody: All your progress, recordings and counts are stored only on this device. Content is marked unverified until a qualified teacher has reviewed it.
settings.clearConfirm: Delete all progress, recordings and counts on this device? This can't be undone.

reminder.title: Time to practice
reminder.body: A few minutes of chanting today 🙏

align.title: Audio alignment
align.intro: Load a recording, play it, and press Space at the start of each syllable.
align.markEnd: Press Mark once more where the last syllable ends.
align.keys: Space plays the audio, then marks each syllable while playing.
align.fineTune: Drag the edges of a region to fine-tune it, then export or try it in the app.
align.useHere: Use in the app on this device
align.saved: Saved. Open the text: karaoke now follows this recording.
